newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bic up on strong turnover figures.
newsitem.headline: Bic up on strong turnover figures.

text.p: Shares in French consumer goods company Bic rose sharply on Thursday after the company reported strong 1996 sales and higher activity in the fourth quarter.
At least three brokers, Exane, Transbourse and CCF Elysees Bourse, changed their recommendations on the stock, raising it to buy from weaker opinions.
Shares were up 4.55 percent at 828 francs, the high for the day.
ABN Amro has a sell on the share, judging it too expensive.
On Wednesday, the company reported a seven percent increase in sales in 1996 compared to 1995.
